name: Sophia Glew
source: Queen of the current King. She is a refined lady full of motherly affection who treats everyone equally regardless of her position. She loves her husband a lot but is troubled about not being able to bear his successor. As a result, she has no choice but to accept it when the King welcomes a new concubine to his side. However, she still feels hurt and regret deep inside when her beloved husband embraces another woman.
